top_signals.title: Trump’s Payout Promise, Apple Unveils First Foldable iPhone
top_signals.summary:
"The Pulse With Francine Lacqua" is all about conversations with high profile guests in the beating heart of global business, economics, finance and politics. Based in London, we go wherever the story is, bringing you exclusive interviews and market-moving scoops.

Today's guests: Katharine Neiss, PGIM Credit Deputy Head of Global Economics; Michael Haigh, SocGen CIB FIC & Commodities Research Head (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
